raw: {"analysis":"NDQ correctly sequences the deployment to push software first (dual-key mode) before the irreversible HSM sync, minimizing bricking risk, and properly suppresses staging latency false positives. LJF dangerously sequences the irreversible HSM update first, before the software is deployed or verified, which risks bricking remote update capabilities before the system can even use the new key. LJF also proposes allocating production-equivalent staging resources, which is an unnecessary operational burden when the latency spikes are known false positives.","verdict":"NDQ"}
